method: Three fresh sessions per variant, sequential full/lean/lean/full/full/lean; zero App-managed warm spares; two real streamed turns per session. Identical wheel files and shared package versions. Cold agent environment, not a claim about provider VM/cache state.
limitations: Small sample; these are not production latency percentiles.
Full control uses the same new integration code as lean, not the exact older released demo wheels.
Optional Genie, direct UC, vector-search, model-logging and CLI compatibility matrices were not exercised. OpenAI imports passed; only LangGraph was invoked live.
First full tool turn took 31.7 s to first text. Its trace has ~3.1 s of model spans; most delay is outside those spans. No attribution to dependency reduction is established.
Stop samples are variable and dominated by waiting for provider status; do not infer a reliable stop improvement.
No UI source changed in this PR; live API/SSE behavior was exercised, not a new browser recording.
